headline: Junior Software Engineer · Digital Health
summary: AI Engineering graduate with distinction who combines software engineering with first-hand experience in medical imaging research. Builds dependable backend, data, and full-stack systems with attention to clean code, validation, practical users, and long-term maintainability. Motivated to apply this foundation to healthcare software that supports clinicians and patients beyond a research prototype.
internship_bullets: Built a Python pipeline for echocardiographic DICOM studies that extracts clinical measurements with OCR and image processing and exports structured data.
Designed resumable batches, validation queues, review tooling, ECG trace extraction, and clear handoff documentation for a medical research workflow.
Developed an OpenCV and DICOM metadata-based source-video matcher, reducing one representative run from roughly 21 hours to 23 minutes.
apolloon_bullets: Built a real-world operations platform with React, TypeScript, Express, Electron, SQLite, tRPC, and Socket.IO.
Translated operator needs into reliable workflows, imports and exports, realtime synchronisation, LAN discovery, health visibility, and safe failover behaviour.
